rows: This form was prepared by the Maintenance Procedures Development and Quality Control Sector of the Holding Company, with the agreement of the MPIS coordinators, for the purpose of quality control of all equipment at power stations of the electricity generation companies
Availability of catalogues and drawings for the unit equipment

Maintenance plans, programmes and reports: - Daily inspection rounds - Weekly maintenance - Monthly maintenance - Half-yearly maintenance - Annual maintenance - Major overhauls and the date of the last overhaul - Replacement and renewal
Programme and reports of periodic measurements and tests carried out to maintain the sound operation of the units
Reorder point status of the spare parts stock required for continuous operation, maintenance and overhauls
Statement listing the damaged parts that were repaired

Special tools & devices — their availability - their condition - a list of them - vibration meter - crack detector (instruments and materials) - pipe thickness gauge - shaft alignment device - torque wrench calibrator - pullers of different sizes for pipes - weld annealing machine - sandblasting machine - other tools and equipment
Calibration: - Statement of the instruments and tools used - Calibration plan as per the manufacturer's instructions - Calibration certificate and review of the correction values - Calibration record

Reports of recurring and chronic faults: - Description of the fault - Causes that led to the fault - Proposed actions to resolve the fault - Contacting similar stations for assistance in resolving the fault - Contacting the manufacturer if the fault cannot be resolved - Reviewing the recurring and chronic fault reports and sending them to the Holding Company, Quality Sector, for publication as a document
Detailed report before and after the major overhaul, covering the following: - Operating data at the performance test - Statement recording all unit readings at 25%, 50%, 75% and 100% of load
Training: - Employee training plan - Evaluation - Training record for technical staff
